goal: Build AgentX Factory Phase 1 Core Engine — YAML pipeline in, synthesized LLM output out, deployed to Cloudflare Workers

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.validationCriteria: npx tsc --noEmit passes. Wrangler compiles. Vitest initializes.

features.title: Project Scaffolding
features.description: Initialize package.json, tsconfig.json, wrangler.toml, vitest.config.ts, stub index.ts. Install all dependencies: hono, zod, yaml, @anthropic-ai/sdk, wrangler, vitest, @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers, @cloudflare/workers-types.

features.title: Core Types
features.description: Define all shared TypeScript types in src/types.ts: Env bindings, HandoffEnvelope, AgentRef, PipelineConfig (ModelDefaults, AgentConfig, PipelineStep, RecoveryConfig, BudgetConfig), DAG types (DagState, DagNode, AgentStatus, RunStatus), PipelineEvent, DispatchMessage, ResultMessage.

milestones.title: Pure Logic Modules
milestones.validationCriteria: All 15 unit tests pass (npx vitest run). No type errors.

features.title: Envelope Helpers
features.description: Create src/envelope.ts with artifactKey(), inputKey(), createDispatchEnvelope(), createResultEnvelope(). TDD with 3 unit tests in test/envelope.test.ts.

features.title: YAML Schema Validation
features.description: Create src/schema.ts with Zod schemas for PipelineConfig, parsePipelineYaml(), validatePipelineConfig(). Create pipelines/code-review.yaml. TDD with 4 unit tests in test/schema.test.ts.

features.title: Gate Evaluator
features.description: Create src/gate.ts with evaluateGate() supporting all_agents_completed and token_budget conditions. TDD with 4 unit tests in test/gate.test.ts.

features.title: Anthropic Client Wrapper
features.description: Create src/anthropic.ts with resolveModel(), buildPrompt(), callAnthropic(). Thin wrapper around @anthropic-ai/sdk. TDD with 4 unit tests in test/anthropic.test.ts.

milestones.title: Durable Objects
milestones.validationCriteria: Agent DO + Supervisor DO integration tests pass via miniflare. DOs initialize SQLite, handle tasks, manage DAG state.

features.title: Agent Durable Object
features.description: Create src/agent.ts — Agent DO class extending DurableObject. SQLite schema for config + history. handleTask(): pull R2 input, call Anthropic, write R2 output, send result envelope to Result Queue. getStatus() RPC method. 2 integration tests.

features.title: Supervisor Durable Object
features.description: Create src/supervisor.ts — Supervisor DO class extending DurableObject. SQLite schema for dag_state + events. initializeRun(): parse YAML, build DAG, create Agent DO IDs, write input to R2, dispatch first step via Queue. handleAgentCompletion(): update DAG, evaluate gates, dispatch next step or complete. getState() and getEvents() RPC methods. 2 integration tests.

milestones.title: Integration & Deploy
milestones.validationCriteria: Full E2E test suite passes. wrangler deploy --dry-run succeeds. Production smoke test on live URL.

features.title: Hono API Router + Queue Consumers
features.description: Replace stub src/index.ts with full Hono Worker: pipeline CRUD (POST/GET/DELETE /api/pipelines), run management (POST/GET /api/runs), artifact retrieval, health check. Queue consumer: route dispatch messages to Agent DOs, route result messages to Supervisor DOs. Export Agent + Supervisor classes.

features.title: E2E Integration Tests
features.description: Create test/e2e.test.ts: health check, pipeline CRUD, run creation + DAG state verification, run listing, reject invalid YAML, reject nonexistent pipeline. 6 integration tests exercising the full Worker via SELF.fetch().

features.title: Deploy Verification
features.description: Run full test suite + type check. Test wrangler dev locally. Create CF resources (KV namespace, R2 bucket, Queues). Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret. wrangler deploy. Smoke test production endpoints.
